name: @mosaicstack/sdk
description: MosAIc SDK - Enterprise AI Development Platform

scripts.setup: npm install && git submodule update --init --recursive && npm run install:all
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix mosaic-mcp && npm install --prefix mosaic-tony && npm run install:packages
scripts.install:packages: npm install --prefix packages/providers && npm install --prefix packages/stack && npm install --prefix packages/config && npm install --prefix packages/cli && npm install --prefix packages/opencode-mcp
scripts.verify: npm run verify:structure && npm run verify:submodules
scripts.test: npm run test:packages && npm run test:submodules && npm run test:automated
scripts.test:packages: npm run test:jest && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:jest: npm run test:config && npm run test:providers && npm run test:cli && npm run test:stack && npm run test:opencode-mcp
scripts.test:config: npm run build --prefix packages/config && npm test --prefix packages/config
scripts.test:providers: npm run build --prefix packages/providers && npm test --prefix packages/providers
scripts.test:cli: npm run build --prefix packages/cli && npm test --prefix packages/cli
scripts.test:stack: npm run build --prefix packages/stack && npm run test:jest --prefix packages/stack
scripts.test:opencode-mcp: npm run build --prefix packages/opencode-mcp && npm test --prefix packages/opencode-mcp
scripts.test:submodules: npm run test:mosaic && npm run test:mcp
scripts.test:mosaic: npm test --prefix mosaic-tony 2>/dev/null || echo 'Tony tests skipped'
scripts.test:mcp: npm test --prefix mosaic-mcp 2>/dev/null || echo 'MCP tests skipped'
scripts.build:mosaic: echo 'Skipping Tony build - TypeScript errors need resolution'
scripts.build:mcp: echo 'Skipping MCP build - TypeScript errors need resolution'
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --prefix packages/config && npm run build --prefix packages/providers && npm run build --prefix packages/cli && npm run build --prefix packages/stack && npm run build --prefix packages/opencode-mcp
scripts.clean: npm run clean:modules && npm run clean:builds
scripts.fresh: npm run clean && npm run setup
